tuition_and_fees.undergraduate_tuition_range: TSh 1,000,000 to TSh 1,500,000 per academic year (varies by degree program/faculty).
tuition_and_fees.direct_university_costs: Direct administrative costs (registration, ID, medical, capitation) typically total TSh 100,000 - TSh 200,000 per year.
tuition_and_fees.payment_portal: All fee payments must be made using a official Control Number generated via ARIS 3.0 or the GePG system.
tuition_and_fees.official_prospectus_note: For exact per-degree tuition rates, students must consult the official UDSM Undergraduate Prospectus or contact the Bursar Office.
